parameter_fields.name: base
parameter_fields.label: Base model ID or local directory
parameter_fields.help: Installed Hugging Face or MLX chat model directory or ID. Empty uses the dataset manifest base, then the selected size.

parameter_fields.name: steps
parameter_fields.label: How long to train
parameter_fields.help: A few hundred steps over a few hundred conversations is a pass or two. Watch the held-out score. One pass over 4,000 harvested turns at batch 4 is 1,000 steps.

parameter_fields.name: context
parameter_fields.label: Longest conversation it reads
parameter_fields.help: Tokens. The tool declarations are rendered into every row: the five graph tools with their worked examples measured 1,080 tokens through the Gemma 4 template, and a row the context cuts off is dropped, not taught.

parameter_fields.name: learning_rate
parameter_fields.label: Learning rate
parameter_fields.help: A full fine-tune of a pretrained model wants a small one; 3e-3 is for training from scratch, and a LoRA wants about 1e-4 because only the adapter moves.

parameter_fields.name: lora
parameter_fields.label: Train an adapter instead of every weight
parameter_fields.help: Two small matrices on each projection, the base frozen: ~0.5% of the weights train, and an 8B model fits where a full fine-tune of it would need ~128G of optimizer state. Needs peft: pip install 'poolhouse[train-lora]'.

parameter_fields.name: lora_rank
parameter_fields.label: Adapter rank
parameter_fields.help: How much the adapter can express, and what it costs. 16 is the usual answer for teaching a format and a habit; 64 is for teaching new knowledge, which this is not.

parameter_fields.name: lora_alpha
parameter_fields.label: Adapter scale
parameter_fields.help: The adapter's update is scaled by alpha/rank, so alpha = 2 x rank keeps that scale at 2 whatever the rank is.

parameter_fields.name: lora_targets
parameter_fields.label: Which projections get an adapter
parameter_fields.help: Comma-separated module names; empty means q_proj,k_proj,v_proj,o_proj,gate_proj,up_proj,down_proj -- attention and MLP both, because a tool caller is being taught what to say and not only what to attend to.

directions.node_to_worker: StudioWorkerNodeFrame only; start/descriptors/input/credit/cancel originate from retained node admission.
directions.worker_to_node: StudioWorkerEventFrame only; startup/accepted/output chunks/descriptors/result/failure/cancel/end are untrusted candidates.
directions.frozen_vs_candidate: Common WorkerFrozenInput/WorkerUtf8Input are only existing immutable input references. Distinct StudioWorkerOutputReservation, Utf8Candidate, LiteralCandidate, OutputCandidate, OutputChunk/End bind produced data to pre-existing staging reservations.

invariants: Catalog metadata and all31 operation field/parameter/result shapes are retained; only22 private worker variants exist. Source-evidenced values/defaults/choices and binary64 bits are preserved in catalog_mapping, not treated as validators.

Origin dataset/model/prompt/tools.call, node import data.hf-preview, and immediate stream.record/record.map/record.if/decision.route remain outside private-worker start/result tags. No tool/network capability follows from their catalog data.

Original request content remains frozen on the node for audit/source-equivalence. Only its digest crosses NodeSnapshot; it is never a second parse, dispatch, parameter or configuration override. Node-selected catalog kind, operation, route, typed result and measured implementation must agree.

Bound source fields using existing limits preserve those limits: record field UTF8 bytes256 and assignment count256; record_ops depth16 and len(json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False).encode()) <=200000; record_context uses separately sorted compact JSON character-count200000. These are distinct metrics, not interchangeable byte bounds.

Some source fields have no demonstrated length/count/expanded-workload limits. Individual frozen/chunked references and streamed descriptors add no invented aggregate cap. Node-admitted profile source evidence and resource/expansion validation remain unresolved before runtime decoding or enablement.

Integer sign+magnitude is exact source integer data, not a guessed32/64-bit seed. Before conversion require canonical ASCII decimal magnitude, no leading zeros except0, no negative zero, and the operation source parser plus node-admitted resource profile. Finite fractions use FiniteF64 with no clamp/round; metadata bits preserve actual rounded source values.

The NaN observation tag is restricted to exactly training final_loss (initial unobserved NaN) and decision training answered_accuracy (no answered cases). It cannot enter admitted controls, probabilities, budgets or arbitrary metrics. Other nonfinite source behavior is an unresolved unsupported runtime profile, never fake0 or a finite fallback.

MLX and Torch LoRA results/plans remain distinct. MLX cached_base_gb is fractional cached-weight storage, total_memory_measured must remain false, unmeasured timing fields remain null. No cache size or engine echo proves actual process peak/working memory.

Every stream slot has one node-fixed direction, purpose/profile, exact expected descriptor variant and exact attempt; indexes are contiguous, counts/bytes/digest match End, slot graphs are acyclic and expanded bytes/resources admitted before decode. Mixed toolcall/metric/reservation descriptors cannot retag or replace slot purpose. No arbitrary list cap is added.

OutputReservation names an existing node-assigned staging slot, exact attempt, fixed media/profile and actual admitted byte/item ceilings. It has no future digest or fabricated completed size. Candidate UTF8/literal/integer/asset bytes must match that exact reservation; worker cannot mint an immutable input or operational handle.

Utf8Reference/LiteralReference immutable_input branches may only echo exact existing node-frozen slots. Newly produced values use candidate branches with distinct direction/custody; node-to-worker descriptors must use immutable references exclusively and may not smuggle candidate slots.

All ancillary transfers authenticate exact slot+attempt+direction+handle; reject duplicate/extra handles while retaining rejected-handle cleanup. No arbitrary paths, URLs, module strings or worker-selected filesystem publication destination are represented. Manifest names are data, not reopen authority; node rejects traversal/symlinks/foreign content.

Every frame binds protocol version/request/job/worker generation/attempt/binding digest/sequence to retained node state. These DTO IDs/digests and profiles are observations, never opaque Binding or proof constructors. No alias to decision-specific common frames/resident proof exists.

Startup/runtime/engine/parser/model/config/temperature/memory messages are candidates only. Node/holder must verify actual selected workload and immutable configuration, not echoes or reported allowances. Worker working memory cannot increase admission.

Input assets require immutable snapshots; read-only worker descriptors alone do not freeze other writers. For output publication node freezes/snapshots exact bytes or revokes ALL writers before hashing/schema checks, then publishes those same frozen bytes after current authorization/attempt/cancellation checks.

Worker output-end/hash, End, success label, toolcall, candidate memory and cancel-observed are not publication, domain completion, cleanup success, scheduling or lease authority. Node alone validates any proposed tool effect through separate authorization.

No data/progress/result after End. One final result only; identical duplicates yield existing disposition without republishing, conflicts refuse. Outstanding/queued chunks require per-frame and aggregate credit bounds from actual admitted profile. Cancellation/revocation blocks late publication; partial output and lost worker retain unresolved custody until responsible holder cleanup.

Current managed-backend HTTP/broker clients, training launches, resident launch attestations and artifact path checks do not implement the reviewed no-network private-pipe/OS boundary. No platform adapter, proof issuer, runtime decoder, scheduler or installed H/K/P acceptance is supplied.

Compare retains the pinned isinstance(value,(int,float)) behavior, including bool-valued training dry_run subtraction yielding integer deltas. It does not sort away source option order or infer authority from any metric/gate.

profiles.source_required: Per-frame/control bytes, total/outstanding credits, compressed/tensor/data expansion, child resource admission and slot handle custody require actual retained native runtime measurements; no new numeric default.
Per-operation text/record/literal parser limits remain separate; source bounded fields above stay exact. Unbounded legacy fields require source-backed node-admitted profile before enablement.
Individually typed records and U64 index/count/bytes are declared; source-backed profile totals/expansion and exact slot element type remain required, never an invented max_items.
Only fixed retained recipe phase semantics may be admitted; unknown callback-produced prepared metadata is disabled, not an arbitrary JSON/byte operation extension.

Closed environment-specific configuration schema beyond the current Studio train config={} and retained policy manifest must be evidenced before decoder; unknown fields/profile cannot be dropped or become arbitrary config dispatch.

Only the evidenced function-call fields/text-vs-literal arguments are declared. Missing/unknown backend extension/schema/version must be resolved without silent field dropping before runtime acceptance.
Frozen all-writer-revoked assets, exact regular-file identity/media/manifest and current authorization checks require real holder/bridge implementation.
FiniteF64 is representation only; source probability/fraction/temperature/learning-rate ranges and explicit NaN result-field cases require exact semantic validation; no implicit numeric coercions.

Measured engine/parser/runtime/model/calibration/source/recipe/LoRA and source checkpoint base/asset validation require native provenance, exact manifest binding and actual startup/first useful workload validation.

unresolved_enablement_blockers: No production private worker pipe/endpoint owner or OS adapter.
No actual source/profile machine validator, bounded expansion/admission decoder, startup native provenance, custody/cancellation/result state machine or publication bridge.
Prepared phase/Gym config/backend/tool-schema profiles remain disabled; source gap is not an arbitrary extension object.
No K worker retention or H/K/P acceptance claim; author leaf plus loader evidence is a checkpoint only.

independent_review.pre_edit: Approved corrected closed declaration strategy with exact slot/direction/order/count/acyclic admission, canonical integer/nonfinite scope and immutable publication constraints.
independent_review.actual_leaf: Approved proposal-only actual263-private-type two-file leaf by /root/domain_attack_review; reviewer independently verified all40 pinned Git source SHA256s and inspected direction/custody/frozen publication constraints. No tests/models executed by reviewer; no parser/runtime/provenance/caller-retention/K proof.

source_catalog_extraction: Offline AST literal extraction plus pinned fixed node_catalog/_model_ports postprocessing; no application import or runtime execution.
